author: Inside Edition
description: Savannah Guthrie and her family have reached out to a Mexican nonprofit organization for help in searching for their kidnapped mom, Nancy Guthrie, south of the US border. They asked the Searching Mothers of Sonora for help. Searching Mothers, which has received 1,300 missing persons since 209 said in a statement, "We will be spreading the word and hoping that the person who took her will have a change of heart and return her."
title: Guthrie Family Asks Mexican Organization To Help In Search

author: Inside Edition
description: Three teens from the same high school died within weeks of each other. They all had undergone hypnosis by their school principal. After an investigation, principal George Kenney was charged with a misdemeanor of practicing therapeutic hypnosis without a license. He pleaded no contest. He was put on probation and resigned. The principal has denied any connection between his sessions and the three deaths. The baffling story is the subject of a new Discovery Plus documentary. The baffling story is the subject of a new Discovery Plus documentary, "The Curious Case Of The Principal Who Hypnotized His School."
title: 3 Students Die After Being Hypnotized by Principal: Docuseries

author: Inside Edition
description: A passenger went to a JetBlue ticket counter at the airport in Las Vegas to get a boarding pass. She was told she needed special documentation to fly with her dog so police say the woman tied up her dog and abandoned her pet. Police found the 26-year-old dog owner at the departure gate. Authorities say the dog owner became so hostile they arrested her for animal abandonment and resisting arrest. After the owner failed to reclaim her dog, Retriever Rescue of Las Vegas took the dog in.
title: Woman Abandons Dog At Airport, Police Say

author: Inside Edition
description: An interesting piece of the past recently came to the surface. Officials in Stockholm say the hull of a 400-year-old warship became visible from the coast of the capital city due to record-low water levels. Now, researchers at the Museum of Wrecks are trying to identify the ship, but they say early observations have already given them a lot of information. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 400-Year-Old Navy Warship Resurfaces In Stockholm

author: Inside Edition
description: A terrifying video from Italy shows a man snatching up a child holding her mother's hand. State police released surveillance video of the incident. They say it shows a mother and child leaving a grocery store in Bergamo, just as a man is entering the store. They say the man picked up the little girl, but the mother never let go. Witnesses came to the child's defense and helped pull the suspect away from her. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Child Suffers Leg Fracture During Attempted Abduction in Italy: Cops

title: Missing Skiers Die In Avalanche #shorts
